body: Ares Capital agreed to acquire MidCap Financial Investment Corporation through a two-step merger, with MFIC stockholders set to receive $1.21 in cash plus Ares Capital shares. The consideration was valued at approximately $10.88 per fully diluted MFIC share when the agreement was signed, subject to adjustments including for certain tax dividends. Ares Capital also obtained voting commitments from two MFIC stockholders covering 4,281,394 shares in aggregate.
